howToEdit: Each Friend generation has a RATING: the percentage of the ball price that a ball pays back on average (the RTP).
Change a number under 'generations', then run: npm run gen:ratings && npm run verify:odds
gen:ratings regenerates the odds tables (games/penalty-kings/tiers/ratings/*.json); verify:odds proves every table is exact.
Ratings are percentages with at most 2 decimals (93, 93.5 and 93.25 are fine). Each must be at least 0 and below 100;
the odds solver keeps the rarity ladder monotone for ratings from 67.5 to 97.5 and rejects anything outside that.
The bonus adds 'points' percentage points when the player's Friend owns/equips the named cosmetic. It is OFF unless 'enabled' is true.
Every rating plus the bonus must stay below 100. See docs/EARLY-ACCESS.md.
